items.concept: Three objections to banning victimless crimes
Drugs as a public-health issue, not a crime
Sex work is a choice of the best available option
Self-ownership and the right to end one's life
Free speech has only one limit: direct incitement
Icky problems: moral instinct versus reason
Even the best states execute innocent people
State capability is a finite budget
Means and ends: give people the power to walk away
Blow oxygen on the spark of doubt
